metric.description: The metric name to inspect for labels.

query.description: Optional substring filter for returned label names or label values.

label.description: Optional label name. Omit this to search label names for the metric; provide it to search values for this label.

limit.description: The maximum number of label names or values to return.

time_range.description: Optional time range used to restrict label discovery.

start.description: The start time in ISO8601 format.

end.description: The end time in ISO8601 format.
